body.statement: For every marginal pair, \[S\in\mathcal V_{\mu,c}\iff\exists(A,B)\in\mathcal F_{\tau}\text{ such that }A-B\subseteq S.\] Consequently, \[k^*=\min_{(A,B)\in\mathcal F_{\tau}}|A-B|,\qquad\mathcal K^*=\{A-B:(A,B)\in\mathcal F_{\tau},\ |A-B|=k^*\},\] where repeated difference sets are deduplicated. The inclusion-minimal valid sets are exactly the inclusion-minimal distinct members of \(\{A-B:(A,B)\in\mathcal F_{\tau}\}\), without positivity, strict Hall slack, or uniqueness assumptions.
body.justification: This boundary-safe normal form replaces optimization over arbitrary unions of effect diagonals by high-mass marginal rectangles.
body.gap: ZhangRichardson2025 treats intervals and single effect values, while Koperberg2024 fixes the allowed relation; neither characterizes every optimizer of the outer set problem.
body.consumer: It reduces the seven-category remdesivir analysis to at most \((2^7-1)^2=16{,}129\) marginal rectangle candidates.
